advancements.recasting.growth.blade.star: Starting point of a growth path.
advancements.recasting.growth.fluorescen: Grows from %s. Complete any fluorescence blade.
advancements.recasting.growth.root.title: Path of Recasting
advancements.recasting.growth.se.root.de: Unlock special effect crystals along their effect chains.
item.recasting.abyss_depth_core.desc: Matte abyss-black swallows faint light, with rare purple flashes deep within.
item.recasting.abyss_flame.desc: Pure matte black that devours surrounding light, forming a silent dark region.
item.recasting.blazing_flame_core.desc: A scarlet-orange flame heart sealed within, scorching yet contained.
item.recasting.blind_phase_transition.de: Golden radiance burned white by blaze, too bright to look upon.
Warm sandalwood rhyme wrapped in scarlet flame, seeping a scorched glow.
item.recasting.chaos_flame.desc: Indeterminate colors, may display any color on the spectrum within the same second.
item.recasting.concealed_edge_phase_tran: An edge hidden between abyss and frost, leaving only a thin cold gleam.
item.recasting.cradle_flame.desc: Soft goose-yellow, its light like the most peaceful candlelight, bringing tranquility to the heart.
item.recasting.craftsman_flame.desc: Steady bronze-yellow with regular flame shape, occasionally flashing with metallic luster.
item.recasting.detonation_phase_transiti: Scarlet flame and frost-blue clash violently within, with bursts of light.
Sandalwood hue bitten away by abyss-black, edges mottled like corrosion.
item.recasting.fire_toxin_phase_transiti: Violet toxin haze seeps from scarlet cracks, thick and unsettling.
item.recasting.frost_vortex_core.desc: Ice-blue and silver swirl slowly within, cold to the touch.
item.recasting.holy_flame.desc: Pure milky white flame, surrounded by a faint golden halo at the edges.
item.recasting.ice_core_flame.desc: Outer layer is blazing bright blue, but the core is deep, absolute dark blue that seems to absorb light.
item.recasting.illuminating_truth_core.d: Milky golden light seeps from the core, clear yet gentle.
item.recasting.interlace_phase_transitio: Gold-white and violet layers interlace, light and dark tearing across the crystal.
item.recasting.karma_flame.desc: Invisible transparent fire, only revealing densely interwoven silver and blood-red threads when burning the threads of fate.
item.recasting.last_words_flame.desc: Amber gold, with a fading starlight representing life's final color sealed deep in the core.
item.recasting.matter_ball.desc: Stores collected items without limits; right-click to fill your inventory, sneak-right-click a container to fill it; vanishes when empty; merges on obtain.
item.recasting.memory_flame.desc: Translucent glazed color, with hazy light and shadow floating in the flame.
item.recasting.mirage_flame.desc: Refracted rainbow colors with blurred edges, as if seen through a layer of mist.
item.recasting.mirror_flame.desc: Highly reflective mirror-like color like mercury, perfectly reflecting the appearance of the flame it 'imitates'.
item.recasting.obsession_flame.desc: Restless orange-red, with pale flashes at the core.
item.recasting.other_shore_flame.desc: Cold bluish-white, flickering like a candle, without warmth.
item.recasting.ouroboros_flame.desc: A self-devouring Möbius ring-shaped flame flow, cycling between silver-gray and dark blue.
item.recasting.poetry_ash_flame.desc: Hazy moon-white, with pale golden runes dancing like text at the core.
item.recasting.proud_soul_bag.desc: Automatically collects and stores proud-soul items without limits; right-click to open a terminal-like interface.
item.recasting.refraction_phase_transiti: Ice-blue light refracts on milky crystal, scattering into faint rainbows.
item.recasting.royal_flame.desc: Majestic dark gold and deep purple interwoven, the flame rising like an imperial crown.
item.recasting.sandalwood_rhyme_core.des: Warm sandalwood-hued light circles within, calm and still.
item.recasting.sin_flame.desc: Foul dark red with ominous black veins, emitting a charred stench when burning.
item.recasting.spread_phase_transition.d: Frost patterns spread along sandalwood veins like ice on bare branches.
item.recasting.tide_flame.desc: With the ebb and flow, colors shift from deep purple at new moon to silvery white like sea foam at full moon.
Gold threads and sandalwood lines wind together into slender cords of light.
recasting.message.proud_soul_drop: You obtained %s. %s can drop again after %s.
recasting.tooltip.abyss_flame.extract: • Anvil: blade+abyss flame removes special SE; blade+gathering parting variant extracts a crystal (blade destroyed)
recasting.tooltip.engraving_rule.erase: • Erase: Use crystals with level 0 to remove SE
recasting.tooltip.engraving_rule.main: • Engrave on anvil: A blade can engrave up to %d normal SEs and %d special SE (special SE can be replaced on the anvil; Creative mode has no restrictions)
recasting.tooltip.engraving_rule.main_un: • Engrave on anvil: SE count limits are disabled
recasting.tooltip.engraving_rule.title: Engraving Rules:
recasting.tooltip.engraving_rule.unlimit: • Current config: normal and special SE engraving counts are both unlimited
recasting.tooltip.engraving_rule.upgrade: • Upgrade: Use crystals with the same type and higher-level SE to increase level.
recasting.tooltip.special_se_extract: • Special SE: blade+abyss flame removes special SE (keeps blade); blade+gathering parting variant extracts a crystal (destroys blade)
se.recasting.annihilation.desc: After summoning a certain number of judgement cuts, additionally summons a giant judgement cut.
se.recasting.black_rose.desc: Records damage dealt on hit and deals periodic damage from the stored amount; stacks decay after each tick.
se.recasting.color_dye.desc: Changes blade color to random when slashing.
se.recasting.command_mapping.desc: Recasts the same phantom-sword art after triggering it.
se.recasting.command_mapping_lambda.desc: Recasts the same phantom-sword art more times after triggering it.
se.recasting.cooperate_with.desc: Has a chance to perform an additional slash when slashing.
se.recasting.cross_chop.desc: Adds a perpendicular cross slash when slashing.
se.recasting.dog_bond.desc: While in inventory, taking damage grants Absorption; if the damage has an attackable entity source, releases Dog Bite on it and consumes durability, with an internal cooldown.
se.recasting.drive_release.desc: Has a chance to release sword qi when slashing.
se.recasting.eat.desc: Consumes durability to restore saturation when slashing.
se.recasting.energy_storage.desc: Stacks layers when dealing damage. Triggers a lightning bolt to attack the target at certain stacks.
se.recasting.enlarge.desc: Greatly increases attack range when slashing. Transplanting this SE onto other blades will lead to misfortune.
se.recasting.fertilize.desc: Applies bone meal to a random nearby crop when slashing.
se.recasting.flame_foam.desc: When attacking a target with soul burn, directly reduces their current health, with a chance to add soul burn.
se.recasting.flame_foam_lambda.desc: When attacking a target with soul burn, directly reduces more of their current health, with a higher chance to add soul burn.
se.recasting.fragment.desc: Stacks layers when phantom swords deal damage. Deals massive additional damage at max stacks.
se.recasting.golden_halberd.desc: Slash hits stack layers; at max, detonates bonus damage nearby.
se.recasting.golden_halberd_lambda.desc: Slash hits stack layers faster; at max, detonates stronger bonus damage nearby.
se.recasting.human_emperor_domain.desc: While in inventory, dispels harmful effects and continually heals, resists knockback, hides the on-fire screen overlay, and grants line-tier damage amp and lethal absorb; resists common instant kills while the blade still holds proud souls, and spends proud souls to repair damaged slash blades in the inventory; automatically spends proud souls to restore hunger.
se.recasting.human_emperor_domain_lambda: While in inventory, dispels harmful effects and heals faster, resists knockback, hides the on-fire screen overlay, and grants stronger line-tier damage amp and more efficient lethal absorb; resists common instant kills while the blade still holds proud souls, and repairs damaged slash blades in the inventory at a lower proud-soul cost; automatically spends proud souls to restore hunger.
se.recasting.impact.desc: Has a chance to summon phantom swords that deal instant damage when dealing damage.
se.recasting.ionization.desc: Stacks ionization on the target when dealing lightning damage, providing all-damage bonus based on stack count. Higher levels stack faster.
se.recasting.judgement.desc: Adds a judgement cut attack when triggering SA.
se.recasting.life_steal.desc: Converts a portion of attack damage into health restoration.
se.recasting.long_sky_sunset.desc: While a target is locked, continuously fires tracking phantom swords at it.
se.recasting.overload.desc: Has a small chance to trigger a judgement cut when slashing.
se.recasting.photon_scar.desc: Laser stacks burn for fire DoT and all-damage amp. While burning, attacks stack scar; at max, fires a short beam and clears.
se.recasting.resolve.desc: When attacking a target with calculus stacks, consumes one stack, deals bonus damage.
se.recasting.resolve_lambda.desc: When attacking a target with calculus stacks, consumes one stack, deals greater bonus damage.
se.recasting.sever_break.desc: Deals massive damage and a wide-range slash after triggering a judgement cut.
se.recasting.spiral.desc: Phantom-sword hits stack momentum; at max, triggers storm phantom swords, then enters an internal cooldown during which stacks no longer build.
se.recasting.split.desc: Launches phantom swords to assist in attacks when slashing.
se.recasting.star_blink.desc: Stacks layers on targets when attacking. Triggers additional damage and resets target velocity at max stacks.
se.recasting.star_blink_lambda.desc: Stacks layers on targets faster when attacking; at max stacks, triggers bonus damage and resets target velocity.
se.recasting.static_afterglow.desc: Dealing damage adds bonus lightning damage; dealing lightning damage may trigger a lightning chain with unrestricted hops.
se.recasting.static_afterglow_lambda.des: Dealing damage adds stronger bonus lightning damage; dealing lightning damage has a higher chance to trigger a lightning chain with unrestricted hops.
se.recasting.storm.desc: Summons phantom swords to attack when triggering a judgement cut.
se.recasting.storm_variant.desc: Summons phantom swords from above to attack when triggering a judgement cut.
se.recasting.stun.desc: Stuns the hit target briefly, preventing movement.
se.recasting.tea_aroma.desc: Hits store partial damage for a one-time release after the timer; consecutive hits accumulate and refresh the timer; drive hits add bonus stacks.
se.recasting.tea_aroma_lambda.desc: Stores more damage for a one-time release after the timer; consecutive hits accumulate and refresh the timer; drive hits add more bonus stacks.
se.recasting.tear.desc: Stacks layers when judgement cuts deal damage. Deals additional damage at max stacks.
se.recasting.thunder_cloud.desc: Targets gain thunder light buff when taking lightning damage. Entities with thunder light take additional lightning damage when damaged.
se.recasting.thunder_gods_wrath.desc: Summons a powerful lightning bolt at the death location when killing an enemy.
se.recasting.thunderstorm.desc: Summons multiple lightning bolts at the target position when triggering SA.
se.recasting.treasure_barrage.desc: Recasts SA once after release, with a short internal cooldown.
se.recasting.treasure_barrage_lambda.des: Recasts SA once after release, with a shorter internal cooldown.
se.recasting.tu_wu_blood_curse.desc: While held, amplifies all damage; lethal hits consume proud souls to absorb damage, and after heavy short-window spending still blocks lethality without further cost; while held, automatically spends proud souls to restore hunger.
se.recasting.tu_wu_blood_curse_lambda.de: While held, amplifies all damage more strongly; lethal hits consume proud souls more efficiently to absorb damage, and after heavy short-window spending still blocks lethality without further cost; while held, automatically spends proud souls to restore hunger.
se.recasting.whirlwind.desc: Your judgement cuts will be allowed to deal repeated damage.
slash_art.recasting.azure_haze: [Back to the Future Plan] Azure Haze
slash_art.recasting.azure_haze.desc: Launches many phantom swords around the caster; when they vanish they burst into spreading sword qi.
slash_art.recasting.blade_storm.desc: Generate numerous high-speed rotating phantom swords at random positions around the player, continuously attacking nearby enemies.
slash_art.recasting.blade_storm_lambda.d: Generate even more high-speed rotating phantom swords at random positions around the player, continuously attacking nearby enemies.
slash_art.recasting.blistering_qi: [Back to the Future Plan] Blistering Qi
slash_art.recasting.blistering_qi.desc: Continually summons tracking phantom swords at the target that burst with a small explosion effect on hit; reusing the art refreshes its duration.
slash_art.recasting.celestial_drive: [Back to the Future Plan] Celestial Drive
slash_art.recasting.celestial_drive.desc: Scatters short-lived sword qi outward in all directions from the caster.
slash_art.recasting.cloud_wheel.desc: Generate multiple summoned swords above the target, including a lightning-calling blade.
slash_art.recasting.cloud_wheel_storm.de: Generate more summoned swords above the target and rain numerous lightning-calling blades.
slash_art.recasting.cyan_glow.desc: Quickly launch multiple slashes at evenly distributed angles in succession.
slash_art.recasting.cyan_glow_lambda.des: Quickly launch multiple slashes at evenly distributed angles in succession.
slash_art.recasting.divine_slash: [Back to the Future Plan] Divine Slash
slash_art.recasting.divine_slash.desc: Fires multiple sword qi along the look direction with shrinking size and varied colors.
slash_art.recasting.dog_bite.desc: Repeatedly bites the locked or cone-selected target; Power enchantment adds extra hits.
slash_art.recasting.eternal_guard: [Back to the Future Plan] Eternal Guard
slash_art.recasting.eternal_guard.desc: Opens a guard domain that pins foes at the world position where they entered, preventing movement.
slash_art.recasting.fanatical_dance.desc: Quickly launch multiple slashes at random angles in succession.
slash_art.recasting.fanatical_dance_lamb: Quickly launch more slashes at random angles in succession.
slash_art.recasting.final_supernova.desc: Unfolds a collapsing black hole at the aim point that consumes blocks and pulls entities, then bursts into rings and deals heavy damage.
slash_art.recasting.fleeting_shadow.desc: Repeatedly flashes beside nearby foes, performing a brief dance of slashes and restoring health after each movement.
slash_art.recasting.fleeting_shadow_lamb: Flashes farther between enemies at a faster rhythm, releasing paired slashes at each pause.
slash_art.recasting.fragment.desc: Perform a slash with repeated attacks and knockback cancellation.
slash_art.recasting.heaven_twelve_hit.de: Launch multiple summoned swords that generate lightning at enemy positions upon hit.
slash_art.recasting.heaven_twelve_hit_la: Launch more summoned swords that generate stronger lightning at enemy positions upon hit.
slash_art.recasting.heavy_payload: [Back to the Future Plan] Heavy Payload
slash_art.recasting.heavy_payload.desc: Delivers a close-range strike to a locked or view-cone target, then detonates a white flash judgement cut on them.
slash_art.recasting.imprisonment.desc: Pins a locked or sightline target at a slowly rising judgement-cut center while continually firing phantom swords around it.
slash_art.recasting.inferno.desc: Summons a large judgement cut at the target; on hit applies soul burn that inflicts ongoing fire damage scaling with current health.
slash_art.recasting.inferno_lambda.desc: Summons a large judgement cut at the target; applies more soul burn stacks on hit.
slash_art.recasting.infinite_bloom: [Back to the Future Plan] Infinite Bloom
slash_art.recasting.infinite_bloom.desc: Opens a judgement cut at the target or look point and rings it with spiral sword qi; with a target, first delivers a close-range strike.
slash_art.recasting.infinite_judgement_c: Launch numerous judgement cuts randomly at enemy positions within range.
slash_art.recasting.jade_domain.desc: Unfolds a lasting Jade Domain that continuously and periodically performs blade releases on random targets. Targets hit by blade release gain Jade Fire, which deals periodic fire damage and amplifies all damage they take.
slash_art.recasting.jade_domain_lambda.d: Unfolds a stronger Jade Domain, releasing more blade releases and summoning more phantom swords to pursue targets.
slash_art.recasting.laser_1.desc: Fires a prism beam from above the head that auto-locks onto foes; on hit, scatters secondary beams outward.
slash_art.recasting.laser_2.desc: Pulses prism beams from above the head with auto-lock; on hit, scatters outward, and secondary beams may scatter again.
slash_art.recasting.laser_3.desc: Rapidly barrages prism beams from above the head with auto-lock; on hit, scatters outward, and secondary beams may scatter again.
slash_art.recasting.laser_3_lambda.desc: Rapidly barrages prism beams from above the head with auto-lock; on hit, beams cascade through successive scatters.
slash_art.recasting.lightning_call.desc: Summon a lightning bolt at the target position.
slash_art.recasting.lightning_chain_1.de: Strike the look-at target, then leap the lightning between nearby enemies.
slash_art.recasting.lightning_chain_2.de: Pulses lightning chains repeatedly, with a wider seek range.
slash_art.recasting.lightning_chain_3.de: Rapidly barrages lightning chains with greater range that can leap back onto already-struck foes.
slash_art.recasting.lightning_chain_3_la: Rapidly barrages lightning chains with greater range that can leap back onto already-struck foes.
slash_art.recasting.long_sky_sunset.desc: Volleys phantom swords at random foes near the aim point, applying Sunset Core on hit. Targets with Sunset Core take radiance and gain Sunset Stack when struck by phantom swords; at full stacks, phantom sword damage rises sharply.
slash_art.recasting.long_sky_sunset_lamb: Volleys more phantom swords at random foes near the aim point, applying Sunset Core on hit. Targets with Sunset Core take radiance and gain Sunset Stack when struck by phantom swords; at full stacks, phantom sword damage rises sharply.
slash_art.recasting.matrix.desc: Create a matrix at the target position that deals continuous damage and stacks calculus, increasing damage taken by targets.
slash_art.recasting.matrix_lambda.desc: Create a matrix at the target that ticks damage faster, stacking calculus to amplify damage taken.
slash_art.recasting.mortal_dust: [Back to the Future Plan] Mortal Dust
slash_art.recasting.mortal_dust.desc: Drops many tracking phantom swords around the caster; hits apply Mortal Dust with splash, amplifying damage taken and dealing extra damage when struck.
slash_art.recasting.multiple_drive.desc: Launch multiple sword qi forward, each with random size and rotation angle.
slash_art.recasting.multiple_drive_lambd: Launch more sword qi forward, each with random size and rotation angle.
slash_art.recasting.multiple_judgement_c: Launch multiple judgement cuts consecutively at the same position.
slash_art.recasting.myriad_silence.desc: Gains Curse Decree: continually sacrifices health to strike the nearest foe in the view cone with black void lightning, stacking Spirit Silence to weaken armor.
slash_art.recasting.myriad_silence_lambd: Gains a longer Curse Decree: continually sacrifices health to strike the nearest foe in the view cone with stronger black void lightning, stacking Spirit Silence to weaken armor.
slash_art.recasting.phantom_explosion.de: Generate multiple groups of spiral phantom swords around the target that rotate around it.
slash_art.recasting.phantom_explosion_la: Generate more groups of spiral phantom swords around the target that rotate around it.
slash_art.recasting.phase_fracture: [Back to the Future Plan] Phase Fracture
slash_art.recasting.phase_fracture.desc: Pulls nearby foes to a focus point ahead, then strikes with phantom swords arranged on a sphere.
slash_art.recasting.phenomenal_return.de: Rains absolute-damage judgement cuts around the look target while dispelling and suppressing beneficial effects on nearby entities.
slash_art.recasting.phenomenal_return_la: Rains longer and wider absolute-damage judgement cuts around the look target while dispelling and suppressing beneficial effects on nearby entities.
slash_art.recasting.rapid_phantom_swords: Summon multiple phantom swords around the target position.
slash_art.recasting.rift_gale.desc: Barrages forward with multiple randomly rolling small sword qi, then finishes with a crossing rift slash.
slash_art.recasting.rift_gale_lambda.des: Releases longer-lasting small sword qi forward, then finishes with a broader crossing rift slash.
slash_art.recasting.sky_seize: [Back to the Future Plan] Sky Seize
slash_art.recasting.sky_seize.desc: Rains many phantom swords from above; when they vanish they strike with lightning and chain to nearby foes.
slash_art.recasting.soul_sever.desc: Unfolds a void-blade curtain, then deals melee damage to struck foes and drops giant judgement cuts at their positions.
slash_art.recasting.soul_sever_lambda.de: Unfolds a void-blade curtain, then deals stronger melee damage and drops more, larger giant judgement cuts.
slash_art.recasting.star_1.desc: Volleys multiple phantom swords at foes in range, each spawning a judgement cut on hit.
slash_art.recasting.star_2.desc: Volleys more phantom swords at a farther range, spawning judgement cuts on hit.
slash_art.recasting.star_3.desc: Volleys a large salvo of phantom swords at extended range, spawning judgement cuts on hit.
slash_art.recasting.star_4.desc: Volleys the widest, densest phantom-sword salvo, spawning judgement cuts on hit.
slash_art.recasting.star_4_lambda.desc: Volleys the widest phantom-sword salvo with judgement cuts on hit, and generates persistent judgement-cut zones that periodically launch summoned swords.
slash_art.recasting.starfall.desc: Unfolds an array: without a lock it follows the caster and drops stars on nearby foes; with a lock it pins the target and keeps raining stars.
slash_art.recasting.stellar_rotation.des: Create a rotating judgement cut at the target position that deals continuous damage.
slash_art.recasting.storm_phantom_swords: Summon multiple phantom swords around the caster and launch them.
Summon more phantom swords around the caster and launch them.
slash_art.recasting.sword_rain.desc: Summon a massive sword rain attack in the area around the caster.
slash_art.recasting.sword_rain_lambda.de: Summon a massive sword rain attack in the area around the caster, concentrating on the target.
slash_art.recasting.tidal_surge: [Back to the Future Plan] Tidal Surge
slash_art.recasting.tidal_surge.desc: For a brief moment, continuously sprays blue sword qi horizontally outward from the caster.
slash_art.recasting.time_beyond: [Back to the Future Plan] Time Beyond
slash_art.recasting.time_beyond.desc: After full charge, accelerates day-night and nearby time flow, then releases a cross drive slash whose power scales with charge time.
slash_art.recasting.unlimited_blade_work: Generate numerous phantom swords evenly distributed on a hemisphere above the target position, launching them with delays.
Generates numerous phantom swords on a hemisphere above the target with delayed volleys, dealing higher damage.
slash_art.recasting.verdict.desc: Launches a massive sword qi that, on hit, summons tracking phantom swords around the target.
slash_art.recasting.void_hole.desc: Creates a judgement-cut void hole at the aim point that repeatedly damages foes while pulling nearby entities inward.
Unfolds an extremely long-lasting judgement-cut void hole with the widest pull range and ongoing damage.
slash_art.recasting.void_hole_pitch_blac: Unfolds a longer-lasting judgement-cut void hole with wider pull range and ongoing damage.
slash_art.recasting.zantetsuden_max.desc: Launch numerous slashes at extremely high frequency at the target position.
slash_art.recasting.zantetsuden_max_lamb: Launch even more slashes at higher frequency at the target position.
slash_art.recasting.zantetsuden_row.desc: Launch numerous drive sword qi in all directions from the target position, scattering in every direction.
slash_art.recasting.zantetsuden_row_lamb: Launch even more drive sword qi in all directions from the target position, scattering in every direction.
